source.review: X1-06 wave 1 — damage spells the prose parser missed because the attack or the bolt is a later Magic action rather than the cast itself. Each definition executes the attack/bolt as the combat action; the sustained part (re-attacking with the blade, calling further bolts) is tracked.

definitions.executionScope: Authored: the thrown flame — a ranged spell attack within 60 feet for 1d8 fire (2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17) as the Magic action. Lighting the flame as a Bonus Action and its light are tracked, not executed.

Authored: one melee spell attack with the blade for 3d6 + spellcasting ability modifier fire (+1d6 per slot level above 2nd). Creating the blade as a Bonus Action, further attacks on later turns, and its light are tracked under concentration.

Authored: the first bolt — creatures within 5 feet of the chosen point (up to four, DM-validated) save against Dexterity for 3d10 lightning, half on success (+1d10 per slot level above 3rd). Later bolts as the Magic action and the outdoor-storm bonus are tracked under concentration.
